prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished believable three-dimensional fantasy RPG inventory product render on a genuinely transparent alpha background. One isolated complete item, centered diagonal from lower left to upper right, occupies about 80% of square canvas with clear margins. Three-quarter view, studio lighting from upper left, crisp readable silhouette at 48px, rich realistic grain and material detail. No floor, scene, pedestal, background shadow, frame, text, logo, hands, wearer, decorative particles or extra objects. No gemstone, no crystal, no glow or magical charge: socket must be visibly EMPTY with dark brown wood interior and open negative space. Subject: Oak Wand. A compact 38cm one-handed magic wand of resin-dark rich chestnut oak, broad prominent oak grain and glossy natural resin finish. Thick elegant sculpted grip occupies one third of length, fine carved interlacing channels on grip and taper. Its tip holds a small EMPTY socket of forged cobalt metal, muted blue-gray metallic prongs with cold steel highlights, visibly open and hollow, nothing in its center. Socket is metal not crystal; inner wooden cup is dark brown. Small matching cobalt grip collar and butt ferrule. Refined sturdy craftsmanship with bevels and tiny fastening pins. Short wand proportions.
